remarks: This classic, all-brick, 2-story townhouse offers 1,554 square feet of well-maintained living space in a quiet, desirable neighborhood within the sought-after Amherst school district, with No HOA. The main level features a spacious family room/bonus room ideal for a home office or media room, a convenient half-bathroom, and a dedicated laundry area complete with a washer and dryer. Upstairs, you will find an inviting living room, an adjacent dining room, and a kitchen equipped with a brand-new gas stove and dishwasher (both August 2026). The second floor also hosts a full bathroom, and 2 bedrooms, including a private balcony off of the primary bedroom—the perfect spot to relax with your morning coffee. Outdoors, enjoy a fenced in backyard patio for dining and an attached 1-car garage with extra storage. Other updates include a new roof, furnace, and central A/C unit, all installed in 2021. Truly move-in ready!
